genius.notes: WSPN is a BVI-domiciled entity with a stated FinCEN MSB registration and pending BVI VASP application. WUSD terms restrict U.S. persons. The GENIUS Act foreign-exception comparability framework remains in proposed-rulemaking (Treasury FR 2026-06489; comment deadline June 2, 2026): no foreign registration can yet be granted. No PPSI approval or US authorization of any kind found.
